descriptions.d24c_script_handle_message_80100250: On ids 64 and 66 call base 0x8016293c; on success call 0x80100490 or 0x80100744 and return 0, else return 0x80004005. Otherwise scan bindings +384 for an entry whose cached message id equals the id: set its +28 to 1, call 0x801036f0 with its handler name, return 0. When bit 15 of the id is set: cached 0x804af16c calls 0x80103a5c; 0x804af174 calls 0x80103c44; otherwise, unless 0x80102734 returns 2, find the message name, copy it, replace dots with underscores, and call 0x801036f0. Finally forward to the base.
